status.en: 4 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 56% fewer than the week before, most of them in Baghdad, Kirkuk and Fallujah.
status.nb: 4 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 56 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Baghdad, Kirkuk og Fallujah.

summary.en: Iraqi security forces are intercepting and destroying explosive-laden drones while a militia leader publicly criticized Iraq’s stance on the Iran blockade, and Iraqi officials met with Trump to reaffirm that Iraq will not be used to attack neighboring countries. A security guard was killed and three people injured in a shooting at an oilfield near Kirkuk, and Turkey is supporting Iraqi counter-ISIS efforts in Kirkuk and reinforcing border posts. The U.S. Embassy warned citizens of security risks, and the UCDP recorded 396 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Irakiske sikkerhetsstyrker avskjærer og ødelegger eksplosivbelastede droner mens en militsleder offentlig kritiserte Iraks holdning til Irans blokade, og irakiske tjenestemenn møtte Trump for å bekrefte at Irak ikke vil bli brukt til å angripe naboland. En sikkerhetsvakt ble drept og tre personer såret i en skyting på et oljefelt nær Kirkuk, og Tyrkia støtter irakiske anti-IS-innsats i Kirkuk og forsterker grensepostene. USAs ambassade advarte borgere om sikkerhetsrisiko, og UCDP registrerte 396 kamprelaterte dødsfall i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Iraqi conflict
background.extract: The Iraqi conflict is a series of violent events that began with the 2003 American-led invasion of Iraq and deposition of Iraqi dictator Saddam Hussein, followed by a series of conflicts including the protracted Iraq War (2003–2011), the Iraqi insurgency (2011–2013), the War in Iraq (2013–2017), and most recently, the small-scale Islamic State insurgency in 4 provinces located in Northern Iraq since 2017.
